name: UniFi Door
author: Vincent Canuel
description: See who is at the door and let them in: the UniFi Protect camera watching it and the UniFi Access door, from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: The door camera's picture, refreshed while the panel is open, and the door's state with an Open button.

schema.label: Console profile (shared with the UniFi plugin)
Camera name or id (empty: the door camera)
Door name or id in UniFi Access (empty: the first door wired to a hub)
Door contact sensor in UniFi Protect, name or id (empty: the first one mounted on a door)
